_comment: 리워드 아이템 그림 작업 목록 (docs/design/item-art/brief.md 2·3·4번). 이미지 모델에 prompt를 한 줄씩 넘긴다(gen_item_art.py). 밥(goma, yakionigiri)과 기본 차림(chef_hat, plain_rice)은 tools/make_onigiri_svg.py가 그리므로 여기에 없다. 넣는 단계(place_item_art.py)의 값: 머리(top)는 kind(hat 모자류 / topping 토핑), box [폭, 높이] 상한 안으로 줄이고, 그림의 닿는 점(anchor, 잘라 낸 그림 안의 비율 [x, y]. 없으면 아래 가장자리 가운데)을 contact(360 좌표계, 없으면 P (150, 110))에 맞춘 뒤 rotate(도, SVG rotate와 같은 부호. 음수면 오른쪽이 올라감)만큼 돌린다(brief.md 2.1.6). 속재료(filling)는 layer(back/front), direction(왼쪽 수평에서 위로 도), depth(E (54, 189)에서 몸 안쪽 거리), length(긴 축 길이), anchor(안쪽 끝, 없으면 오른쪽 가장자리 가운데)로 놓는다(brief.md 2.3.5·2.3.6). 배경(background)은 targetBox 360×360과 kanaBoxes(그림에 합성할 가나와 자리)다. 기리 좌표는 모두 360 좌표계(viewBox -30 0 360 360).

items.prompt: A simple front view of a small Japanese eatery entrance: a dark indigo split noren curtain hanging across the top-left of a wooden doorway, light cream plaster wall, a little potted plant at the bottom-right edge. The center of the picture is a calm, very light, almost empty wall area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.

One thick slice of Japanese tamagoyaki (sweet rolled omelette) shown alone as a flat object, front view: a soft rounded rectangle slab in warm yellow, bent into a gentle arch with the middle higher than the two ends, like a shallow upside-down U, with one narrow dark seaweed band wrapped around its middle from top to bottom. Only the omelette slice and the seaweed band, nothing under it.

One single slice of tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet) shown alone as a flat object, tilted so the cut face is visible: a thick crust in warm wood brown with a softly wavy outline, and a pale cream cut face of meat inside. The bottom edge is gently rounded. Only one slice, no cabbage, no sauce, no crumbs, no plate.

One chikuwa (Japanese tube-shaped fish cake) lying sideways, shown alone as a flat object, gently curved like a shallow arch with the middle higher than the ends, slightly turned so one open end with its round dark hole is visible. Off-white ends and a wide toasted warm brown band covering the middle. Only the one tube, no sauce, no seaweed powder.

One shrimp tempura (ebi tempura) lying horizontally, shown alone as a flat object: a long body in warm yellow batter with a softly wavy outline, the right end cut straight across, and at the left end a small fan-shaped orange red shrimp tail sticking out. Only the one tempura, no sauce, no crumbs, no plate.

A simple, completely empty Japanese train station platform with nobody on it: pale sky, a blank station name board on two short posts at the top-left, a yellow tactile line along the platform edge at the bottom, a bit of a train window at the right edge. The middle of the picture is just empty pale platform and sky. Leave the station name board blank with no letters.

One chunk of grilled salted salmon (shake) lying horizontally, shown alone as a flat object: a rounded wedge in soft salmon orange with two thin curved off-white fat lines across it, the right end cut straight across. No skin, no grill marks. Only the one salmon piece.

A simple shrine approach: a vermilion torii gate framing the picture with its top beam across the top and its two pillars at the left and right edges, a light stone path in the middle, soft green-grey shrubs at the bottom corners, pale sky. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area.

A cute white festival fox mask (kitsune omen) floating alone, front view tilted about 20 degrees: white face shape with pointed fox ears, simple orange-red markings, empty eye holes, a thin cord loop at the side. Only the flat mask itself, nothing behind or under it.

A twisted cloth headband (nejiri hachimaki) shown alone as a flat object, front view: a thick rope-like band made of only two colors, dark indigo blue and white, twisted together in a spiral, bent into a wide shallow upward arc like a smile (not a closed ring), with a small knot and two short tails at the right end. Only indigo and white, no other colors.

A simple bathhouse entrance: an indigo noren curtain hanging at the top-left, warm wooden frame, a light wooden floor and a pair of small sandals at the bottom-right edge, faint soft steam curls. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.
A small folded tenugui hand towel lying flat, front view: white cotton with a simple indigo wave pattern, folded into a neat flat rectangle, slightly tilted. Only the folded towel, nothing under it.

One small round Japanese steamed bun (onsen manju) shown alone as a flat object, front view: a soft low dome with a flat bottom, warm wood brown top and a narrow pale cream band along the lower side. Plain and smooth with no stamp, no mark, no text. Only the one bun, whole and uncut, nothing under it.

One Japanese pickled plum (umeboshi) shown alone as a flat object, front view: a round slightly squashed ball in soft orange red with one or two short curved wrinkle lines on its surface. No leaf, no seed, no stem, no bowl. Only the one plum.
